data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement defense-store-to-thread-resolve.sh adapter that watches the defense store, locates records with non-null github_comment_id, and calls the resolveReviewThread GraphQL mutation against the corresponding GitHub thread. Covers both arbiter rulings (DROP/DEFER) and llm-reviewer accepted-defense outcomes.

**Why**: This is the user-visible win: engineers stop seeing accumulating bot review threads on their PRs. It also closes today's parallel gap where llm-reviewer accepted defenses leave threads unresolved.

**Scope**:
- IN: defense-store-to-thread-resolve.sh adapter; resolveReviewThread GraphQL mutation; observation window <=60 seconds; graceful skip on absent github_comment_id (INFO log); coverage of all four outcomes (arbiter DROP, arbiter DEFER, arbiter ACCEPT, llm accepted-defense)
- OUT: Defense record schema (covered by d4); per-bot ingestion (covered by d3); CI workflow wiring (covered by d7)

## Done Definitions
- When this story is complete, dropped_by_arbiter with github_comment_id -> resolveReviewThread within 60s
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")
- When this story is complete, defended_accepted (llm, no arbiter) -> same auto-resolve
  ← Satisfies: sc-4  (sc-4: "**Today's gap fixed simultaneously**: when our own llm reviewer's defense is accepted (without involving the new arbiter), the original review-comment")
- When this story is complete, Missing github_comment_id -> INFO skip + 0 mutations
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")
- When this story is complete, Cold start: seeds cursor to HEAD, cursor_initialized marker, 0 historical mutations
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")
- When this story is complete, Missing pull-requests:write: probe exits non-zero with clear error before any mutation
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")

## Considerations
- [Reliability] resolveReviewThread requires pull-requests: write workflow permission — verified by d7 SC10
- [Performance] 60-second window includes the adapter's defense-store poll interval; budget poll cadence accordingly
- [Testing] Each of the four outcome paths needs a config-isolated integration test (bug-5f2a-9a9f)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an engineer reading my PR, I can see that DROP/DEFER/ACCEPT defense outcomes auto-resolve their GitHub review threads within 60 seconds so bot and llm-defended threads stop accumulating unresolved
